Keep exactly the same coil winding, exposed steel strip tail at upper left, all original posts, central three posts, side ribs, injection molding marks, scratches, material colors and uneven natural steel reflections. Do not reconstruct or invent microscopic detail, sharpen dramatically, alter the shape, add a lid, add a brand, add labels, remove any internal parts, or change any post positions. The case is already almost fully visible: preserve its existing contour and do not invent hidden corners. No text, no watermark. Natural subtle shadow outside case on the white background. Output square image.
